beats.care: If you live or work near Gachibowli or the Financial District, this could make airport trips much cheaper once fares are announced.
beats.what: TGSRTC is planning a luxury AC Pushpak service from Patancheru to the airport, via Lingampally, Nallagandla, Gopanpally, Financial District, Kokapet and Narsingi.
beats.why: Private cabs from Patancheru and nearby areas reportedly charge 1,300 to 1,800 rupees to the airport, and many IT staff fly early or late.

cards.body: TGSRTC will need extra buses, possibly dedicated luxury ones, to run it. Boarding points and frequency are still being worked out.
Pushpak is TGSRTC's AC bus brand for airport routes, with luggage space, running from different parts of the city to Shamshabad.

opts: Cabs from the west side are expensive
cards.q: Why is TGSRTC planning this new airport route?
cards.why: A bus gives western Hyderabad residents a cheaper option than ₹1,300+ cab rides.

hook: Paying *₹1,300+ for an airport cab* from the west side? A bus may be coming

learn.t: TGSRTC already runs 55 Pushpak AC buses on airport routes; this one would use the ORR from Narsingi to Shamshabad.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: TGSRTC mulls new Pushpak route to RGIA

tldr: TGSRTC plans a new Pushpak AC bus from Patancheru to RGIA via Lingampally and the Financial District, for western Hyderabad.
watch: TGSRTC says the route could start in the coming months. Fares and timings are not announced yet.
